options.opa: A two-electrode assembly is used and the current passes between the working electrode and the reference electrode.
options.opb: A two-electrode assembly is used and no current passes between the working electrode and the reference electrode.
options.opc: A three-electrode assembly is used and the current passes between the working electrode and the reference electrode.
options.opd: A three-electrode assembly is used and the current passes between the working electrode and the auxiliary electrode.
